(?fsm:later_generated_select

  (+system
    (clock clk)
    (sreset rst_n active_low)
  )

  (+interface
    (input request)
    (input allow)
    (input datain)
    (input other)
    (output seen)
    (output done)
  )

  (+size
    (request 1)
    (allow 1)
    (datain 3)
    (other 3)
    (seen 3)
    (done 1)
    (main_worker_do_0_start 1)
    (main_worker_do_0_done 1)
    (main_worker_do_0_payload 3)
    (main_worker_do_0_result 3)
    (can_accept 1)
  )

  (main_idle_0
    (= (can_accept 1))
    (<request
      (-> main_do_1)
    )
  )

  (main_do_1
    (= (main_worker_do_0_start> 1))
    (<main_worker_do_0_done
      (-> main_done_2)
    )
  )

  (main_done_2
    (<1 (done> 1))
    (-> main_idle_0)
  )

  (-main_worker_do_0_port_bindings
    (= (main_worker_do_0_payload> datain))
    (= (seen> main_worker_do_0_result) <main_worker_do_0_done)
  )

)

(actor later_generated_select
  (clock clk) (reset (rst_n sync active_low))
  (interface (input request) (input allow) (input datain (width 3)) (input other (width 3)) (output seen (width 3)) (output done))
  (transaction worker
    (ports (input payload (width 3)) (output result (width 3)))
    (params (MODE 1)) (on request) (select result allow payload other) (complete done))
  (transaction main (on request)
    (do worker (params (MODE 1)) (bind (input payload datain) (output result seen)))
    (complete done)))
